chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Walad Al-Hannat, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah عليه السلام about a man who married during his illness. He said: “If he consummated the marriage with her and then died during his illness, she inherits from him. But if he did not consummate the marriage with her, she does not inherit from him, and his marriage is invalid.”

key_terms.فِي مَرَضِهِ: during his illness, referring to the illness in which death occurs
key_terms.لَمْ تَرِثْهُ: she does not inherit from him

ai.seo_question: Does a wife inherit if a man marries her during his illness and then dies?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about a man who marries while in his final illness. If he consummates the marriage and then dies in that illness, the wife inherits from him; if he does not consummate it, she does not inherit, and the marriage is deemed invalid.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5667 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Walad Al-Hannat, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who married during his illness.
Imam (as) said: "If he consummated the marriage with her and then died during his illness, she inherits from him. However, if he did not consummate the marriage with her, she does not inherit from him, and the marriage is invalid."
